playbook_rules.text: One open trade at a time. No averaging, no second position, no hedge.
Risk 0.5% of current equity per trade. Size from the actual stop distance. Skip if below 0.01 lots.
Always a hard stop beyond structure. No mental stops.
Do not take a trade that cannot offer at least 1.5R to TP1 at the planned fill.
Close half at 1.5R (TP1), move the runner to breakeven, leave the rest to 3R or the next structure level.
Daily loss stop: −2% realized. No new trades that COMEX session.
Max two new attempts per session, and only if the first is already closed.
Kill switch, valid_until, and news blackout in the decision file are binding.
Priority: blackout/loss-stop/kill → Asia breakout (A) → optional NY with-trend sweep (B) → discretionary downtrend supply rejection → NONE.
Do not chase a breakout already more than half the Asia range through the level. Do not short a live rally just because price reached a sell zone — wait for a rejection close.
